patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: Rangarajan committee = financial inclusion, NABARD launched SHG-bank linkage pilot, NPCI launched RuPay, MUDRA targets micro and small enterprises.
APPSC 2024-25 items test traps: DPI base year March 2018 (not 2021), digital payments shifted MeitY -> DFS, NFS = largest ATM network, France first European UPI country.
Number facts recur: MUDRA collateral-free limit (Rs 10 lakh in 2022 key; now Rs 20 lakh with Tarun Plus), Kishore Rs 50,001-5 lakh, PMSBY age 18-70.
UPSC-style statement items on payments banks, UPI vs CBDC, RTGS vs NEFT and FI-Index sub-indices appear in the pool.
App MCQs are heavy on 2025-26 data (UPI shares, PMJDY counts, zero-MDR bill) and multi-statement items; APPSC questions are shorter and more definitional.
